x: Held at Tooting Track on August 2nd, before a large crowd, and some good racing was seen. Ted Read retained his 100 yards title, with a newcomer in G.

Our annual track meeting was held at Tooting Bec, and although it was a really glorious morning our members were evidently still recovering from the effects of the night before, judging by the limited number who turned up. We managed to make up three heats for the 100 yards handicap, which resulted…
